title: Actin force production in clathrin-mediated endocytosis (Akamatsu et al. 2020)
description:
Biology: Two different methods reach the same number. A simulation says about 200 Arp2/3 complexes are needed, and a count in live cells finds about 200. Each is its own run, under its own protocol, and both support one claim. A worked example for Discourse Graphs, read from the paper by hand. The paper's own text and figures are not included.

An RO-Crate: open README.md or ro-crate-preview.html inside the archive to read it. Every finding is also described in the MIRA schema.
